frequency_question: What proportion of expiring bilateral water treaties successfully achieve a formal written renewal or extension agreement within the target window prior to or at expiration?
membership_rule: Includes formal treaties between sovereign states specifically governing shared transboundary river flows with explicit expiration or review clauses requiring active renewal. Excludes informal understandings, unilateral declarations, and multilateral basin conventions.

cases.name: 1996 Indo-Pakistani Indus Waters Treaty (Permanent Indus Commission operational reviews / extensions)
1992 Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase updates

coverage_note: 6 named; estimated roughly 8 major bilateral water treaties with strict renewal thresholds globally in the period.
known_gaps: Excludes minor or undocumented bilateral arrangements in Central Asia and Africa lacking public record in standard treaty databases.
skeleton: Total qualifying bilateral water treaty renewal events identified globally divided into those resulting in formal signed extensions versus lapses or indefinite stalemates.
validity_reason: International water law norms and state practice regarding transboundary river basin management evolve slowly over decades.
